status: Design specification only; implementation and synthetic checks must be frozen before any bridge model run. No joint-search outcomes reported in this draft.
scope: Already-consulted development data, not independent confirmation. Original E18 primary endpoint/outcomes unchanged.
selection_reason: Known raw-feature tasks spanning low-dimensional expression and two facial-rating/expression representations, chosen to bound execution cost; no claim that3tasks represent all16families.
outer_cases: Reuse all3E11heldout folds per family, original fit/query rows and original-test exclusion; nine base cases. G/U each,18jobs, two tolerances each gives36search endpoints.
oracle: Parent calibrated prototype model, beta1,zeta0.5, geometry-only exact-budget bisection, k5, prior alpha_p0.5, K=max(1,floor(n_fit/2)). Full-fitted profiles/scales/prior fixed through all subsets. Retained subsets regranulate. Empty predicts original fitting-label mean. Parent deterministic ties and constant-geometry behavior retained.
reference_primary: Per-mode/per-K Full direct-training-prediction errors e_i(A,K,mode), fixed throughout each search. Each Full starts feasible; costs across modes have different reference/oracle constraints and are not a matched-constraint geometry superiority comparison.
tolerances: epsilon_i=lambda*V0 for every i; V0=mean_i||L_i-p||^2; lambda in[0,0.05], numerical acceptance slack1e-12 fixed. V0zero has explicit mean-only exact-zero handling.
common_reference_diagnostic: Uniform Full singleton endpoint e_i(A,n,UU), shared across modes. For each mode and tolerance, report whether compressed Full(A,K) satisfies these bounds, violating-object count and maximum excess. No infeasible initialization is passed to the stopping theorem and no common-reference search outcome is imputed.
costs: Integer1..10 generated by numpy default_rng(202611190000+parent_family_index), common across folds and both modes of that feature family; simulated prices, not measured acquisition times.
search: Complete descending-cost deletion sweeps with original-feature-index ties. Successful deletion continues current sweep; revisit rejected features next sweep. Empty or complete unsuccessful sweep terminates. Maximum2000candidate requests per tolerance and1800wall seconds per geometry job, checked between oracle calls. Capped searches explicitly incomplete; no single-deletion certificate unless independently verified and labeled as such.
retained_evidence: All evaluated subset masks/errors, acceptance flags, fixed-reference errors, terminal losses and exported predictors retained privately. Final single-deletion errors re-evaluated independently from the terminal state. Original Full and terminal heldout outputs sealed for all18jobs before scoring. No favorable restart, seed substitution or post-outcome tolerance choice.
analysis: Report initialization, per-object feasibility, completed/capped status, terminal certificate, cost fraction, remaining feature count, same-layout predictor bytes and heldout Brier plus six metrics. Both tolerances and all modes/cases retained. Search feasibility and prediction are separate outcomes. No universal cost advantage or joint global optimum claim.
inputs: Existing canonical NPY/cache, parent hashes checked before fitting; no repeat download. No raw/per-object data public. Frozen source code/protocol and aggregate results only on GitHub. User-authorized private Drive cache for allocations/errors/predictions.
